What it does

The whole school, not just the fee counter

One price. Every module. No add-ons to buy later.

Fees and challans

One parent pays once for all their children. Monthly challans, arrears carried forward, partial payments, fines, approved discounts, and a receipt number that cannot skip.

How fee collection works

Attendance

A daily register per class, marked from a phone in the classroom, that keeps working when the internet does not. Finalise, lock, and print the monthly sheet.

How attendance works

Exams and result cards

Marks per paper, practicals and weightage, grades computed on your own scale, then printed result cards, tabulation sheets and class positions.

How exams work

Accounts and payroll

An expense ledger with categories, other income, cash drawer sessions, a day book, staff salaries, and the monthly profit that follows from all of it.

How the accounts work

Parent portal

Parents sign in on their own phone and see their own children only: balance, every receipt, attendance day by day, and results once you publish them.

How the portal works

And the rest of it

Admissions with automatic GR numbers and sibling linking. Staff records and teacher logins. Leaving, character and bonafide certificates on tracked serial registers. Student and staff ID cards. Year end rollover for the whole school in one pass.

Your records

Your records leave with you

Export everything you have entered, at any time, in a plain readable format, including on the day you decide to leave. There is no lock in and no fee for your own data.

And nothing is ever quietly removed. A wrong entry is corrected by a reversal, so both lines stay in the record with a reason and a name. If somebody asks in two years why a receipt was cancelled, the answer is still there.
